s0401.literal: On yisi day, the Square Bright Altar was established at Lou Lake.
s0401.idiomatic: On yisi day they set up the Square Bright Altar at Lou Lake.

s0402.literal: On wushen day, Central Guard General and Yangzhou Inspector Prince Shixing of the Beginning-Prosperity line, Shuling, was also made royal officer and covenant lord to preside at the oath.
s0402.idiomatic: On wushen day Central Guard General and Yangzhou Inspector Prince Shixing, Shuling, was also appointed covenant lord to preside at the oath.

s0403.literal: On jiayin day, the imperial carriage went to Lou Lake to witness the oath.
s0403.idiomatic: On jiayin day the emperor went to Lou Lake to witness the oath.

s0404.literal: On yimao day, envoys were dispatched in separate directions to circulate the covenant oath throughout the realm, that high and low might warn one another.
s0404.idiomatic: On yimao day envoys were sent out to publish the covenant oath in every quarter, so that court and country might hold one another to account.

s0405.literal: On renxu day, General Who Proclaims Grace Prince Jiangxia, Boyi, was made Inspector of Eastern Yangzhou.
s0405.idiomatic: On renxu day General Who Proclaims Grace Prince Jiangxia, Boyi, was appointed inspector of Eastern Yangzhou.

s0406.literal: In the tenth month, on wuyin day, Yi Province and the two commanderies Langye and Pengcheng were abolished.
s0406.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuyin day, Yi Province and the commanderies of Langye and Pengcheng were abolished.

s0407.literal: Jianxing was established, administering six counties—Jian'an, Tongxia, Wushan, Jiangcheng, Linyi, and Hushu—and placed under Yangzhou.
s0407.idiomatic: The prefecture of Jianxing was created, governing six counties—Jian'an, Tongxia, Wushan, Jiangcheng, Linyi, and Hushu—and attached to Yangzhou.

s0408.literal: On wuzi day, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Shan was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
s0408.idiomatic: On wuzi day Left Vice Director Lu Shan was promoted to Director of the Masters of Writing.

s0409.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, General Who Pacifies the West Sun Yu was made Inspector of Yingzhou.
s0409.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, General Who Pacifies the West Sun Yu was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.

s0410.literal: In the twelfth month, on yihai day, the Lujiang barbarian of He Province, Tian Boxing, came out raiding Zongyang; Inspector Lu Guangda attacked and pacified him.
s0410.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yihai day, the Lujiang tribesman Tian Boxing of He Province raided Zongyang; Inspector Lu Guangda defeated and pacified him.

s0411.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year, in the first month, on dingyou day, a dragon appeared beside the Yongning Tower pool in Southern Yanzhou.
s0411.idiomatic: In spring of the eleventh year, on dingyou of the first month, a dragon was seen in the pool by the Yongning Tower in Southern Yanzhou.

s0412.literal: In the second month, on guihai day, the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
s0412.idiomatic: In the second month, on guihai day, the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

s0413.literal: In the third month, on dingwei day, an edict said: "Those righteous men north of the Huai who lead households back to the realm shall have their original prefectures and counties restored under their old names, with prefectures and counties set up and attached to the nearest province; fields and dwellings shall be allotted, and they shall be called up for service without any advance levy."
s0413.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei day, an edict said: "Loyalists north of the Huai who bring their households home may restore their old prefectural and county titles, with new districts placed under the nearest province; they shall receive fields and houses, and no levy shall be taken before they are enrolled."

s0414.literal: [Summer] In the fifth month, on yisi day, [25] an edict said: "Of old the Yellow Emperor charged Feng Hou and Li Mu; Yao consulted Ji, Qi, Zhu, and Wu; with the royal capstrings hanging down he ruled at ease, and peace and abundance came."
s0414.idiomatic: [Summer] In the fifth month, on yisi day, [25] an edict said: "In antiquity the Yellow Emperor appointed Feng Hou and Li Mu; Yao sought counsel from Ji, Qi, Zhu, and Wu; with capstrings hanging down he ruled at ease until the age turned peaceful and rich."

s0415.literal: Down to Han, when the Five Bureaus were arrayed, and Zhou, when the Six Duties were divided—offices were set and affairs governed, each with its charge—still they nearly reached the age when punishments were laid aside and their reigns were prolonged, all relying on many talents to secure the people's achievements.
s0415.idiomatic: Under Han the Five Bureaus were set in order; under Zhou the Six Duties were divided—each office had its charge—yet they nearly reached an age when punishments fell still and their lines endured, because many able men upheld the people's work.

s0416.literal: We toil from dawn to dusk, thinking to spread good rule, yet business still piles up and the way of government is not settled; evening vigilance fills Our breast, and We do not know how to cross over.
s0416.idiomatic: We labor from dawn to dusk to advance good government, yet affairs still pile up and policy does not take shape; evening after evening We lie awake, not knowing how to cross the flood.

s0417.literal: We wish now to lean on this boat and oar and entrust the work to Our arms and thighs, seeking names and testing realities, to bring quiet to many officers.
s0417.idiomatic: We mean now to lean on this vessel and entrust the helm to Our ministers, matching name to deed, that many officers may find their rest.

s0418.literal: From now on, all documents of the Masters of Writing bureaus, offices, temples, inner directorates, supervisors, and clerks shall be handed to the bureaus for joint deliberation and divided judgment.
s0418.idiomatic: Henceforth all papers of the Masters of Writing, government offices, temples, inner directorates, and clerks shall go to the bureaus for joint review and divided decision.

s0419.literal: Matters of military affairs, state construction, levies and conscription, appointments and seniority, and the three prisons must first be judged in detail and only then reported upward.
s0419.idiomatic: Military affairs, public works, levies and conscription, appointments and seniority, and the three prisons must all be fully judged before they are reported up.

s0420.literal: In every decision, clarity and order are to be sought; hold to law and keep the system, compare as if drawn with one line—do not let front and back contradict and clash with one another, causing wrongful delay.
s0420.idiomatic: Every ruling must be clear and fair; hold to law and one standard, as if drawn with a single line—let no contradiction between earlier and later rulings bring wrongful delay.

s0421.literal: Those who bend intent and play with the text, or who hear of wrongdoing and do not impeach—none shall be pardoned.
s0421.idiomatic: Whoever twists the law for favor, or hears of wrongdoing and does not impeach, shall not be spared.

s0422.literal: On jiayin day, an edict said: "The old statutes treated taking bribes while perverting the law as a heavy crime, yet taking bribes while upholding the law was very lightly punished—would this not lengthen the greedy and cruel and breed manipulation?
s0422.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict said: "Old law punished taking bribes while bending the law severely, yet taking bribes while upholding the law lightly—does that not feed greed and invite fraud?

s0423.literal: When affairs touch goods and wealth, should the penalty not be especially severe?
s0423.idiomatic: When wealth is involved, should the penalty not bite all the harder?

s0424.literal: Now one who takes bribes without perverting the law may be sentenced the same as outright theft."
s0424.idiomatic: Henceforth one who takes bribes without bending the law shall be punished like a common thief."

s0425.literal: In the sixth month, on gengchen day, General Before the Van Prince of Yuzhang, Shuying, was made General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
s0425.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen day, General Before the Van Prince of Yuzhang, Shuying, was made General Who Guards the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

s0426.literal: On jingxu day, General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince of Poyang, Boshan, was made Central Authority General and Protector of the Army.
s0426.idiomatic: On jingxu day General Who Campaigns South and Jiangzhou inspector Prince of Poyang, Boshan, was made Central Authority General and Protector of the Army.

s0427.literal: In the seventh month, on xinmao day, the great cash of six zhu was first put into use.
s0427.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinmao day, the great six-zhu coin was first issued.

s0428.literal: In the eighth month, on jiazi day, the righteous leader of Qingzhou, Zhu Xianzong, and others led seven hundred households of their following to submit.
s0428.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi day, the Qingzhou loyalist Zhu Xianzong and others brought seven hundred households into allegiance.

s0429.literal: On dingmao day, the imperial carriage went to the Grand Splendor Viewing Terrace to review the troops.
s0429.idiomatic: On dingmao day the emperor went to the Grand Splendor Terrace to review the troops.

s0430.literal: On wuyin day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
s0430.idiomatic: On wuyin day the emperor returned to the palace.

s0431.literal: In the tenth month, on jiaxu day, General Before the Peace and Master of the Court for Imperial Sacrifices Prince of Jin'an, Bogong, was made Military Adviser General; Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Shan was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
s0431.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiaxu day, General Before the Peace and Master of Sacrifices Prince of Jin'an, Bogong, was made Military Adviser General; Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Shan was made Left Vice Director.

s0432.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, an edict said: "The painted cap was not to be violated, yet this shallow custom is to be changed; the punishment of wife and children was trodden underfoot, and the people were transformed toward meanness.
s0432.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, an edict said: "The painted cap was not to be touched, yet this shallow age must be changed; kin punishment was once enforced, and the people were turned toward hardness.

s0433.literal: We solemnly received the precious mandate and are nearing a full cycle, thinking to govern the state and aid the people, toiling from sun to sun and resting only at midnight, yet to return to purity and simplicity the way has no steps, and the flourishing peace of Yongxi—who can bring it?
s0433.idiomatic: We solemnly received Heaven's charge and are nearing a full twelve-year cycle, laboring to govern the realm and cherish the people from dawn to midnight, yet the road back to plain honesty has no foothold, and who can restore the glory of a golden age?

s0434.literal: Thus the documents of interrogation fill Our audience, and those at the pestle and fetters crowd the prisons.
s0434.idiomatic: Interrogation papers overflow Our desk, and men at the mortar and in chains crowd the jails.

s0435.literal: Under King Cheng punishments were laid aside; under Emperor Wen of Han, suits ceased—yet the loom stands idle in vain, and that age is far away.
s0435.idiomatic: King Cheng left punishments unused; Emperor Wen of Han emptied the courts—yet the loom stands idle in vain, and that age is far beyond us.

s0436.literal: Moreover the petty rebel bands leap beyond Our Peng and Bian; the people of Huai and Ru crane their necks for the royal plan; We marshal troops and swear the host, meaning to save them.
s0436.idiomatic: Moreover petty rebels overrun Peng and Bian; the people of Huai and Ru look to the throne; We raise armies and swear the host to deliver them.

s0437.literal: Flying fodder and hauling grain—levies are very burdensome; in summer rain and winter cold, how can complaints be forgotten?
s0437.idiomatic: Grain is rushed forward and taxes press hard; in summer rain and winter cold, who can forget the people's groans?

s0438.literal: Moreover the lodges of the heavens are out of place and the stations of the lodges stray from their positions; as the admonition of Ruo says, the blame returns to the sovereign—guilt piles in Our heart, and to drive rotten wood is not Our fear alone.
s0438.idiomatic: The lodges of heaven are awry and the stations stray; as the Book of Ruo warns, the fault lies with the ruler—guilt piles in Our heart, and to drive a rotted axle is not Our fear alone.

s0439.literal: Now in the month of the Establishment of the Son, when slight yang first stirs, meeting this good season, a broad grace should be spread—let there be a great amnesty for all under Heaven."
s0439.idiomatic: Now in the month when the Son is established, as slight yang first stirs, meeting this good season We should spread a broad grace—a great amnesty for all under Heaven."

s0440.literal: On jiawu day, Zhou sent Pillar of State Liang Shiyan leading troops to Feikou.
s0440.idiomatic: On jiawu day Zhou sent Pillar of State Liang Shiyan with an army to Feikou.

s0441.literal: On wuxu day, the Zhou army advanced and besieged Shouyang.
s0441.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Zhou army advanced and besieged Shouyang.

s0442.literal: On xinchou day, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Opener of the Mansion with Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou Chunyu Liang was made Commander of the Upper Reaches Water Army;
s0442.idiomatic: On xinchou day General of Chariots and Cavalry, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Southern Yanzhou inspector Chunyu Liang was made commander of the upper-reaches water forces;

s0443.literal: Central Army Commander Fan Yi was made Area Commander of the Northern Campaign with the additional title General Who Pacifies the North;
s0443.idiomatic: Central Army Commander Fan Yi was made area commander of the northern campaign and promoted to General Who Pacifies the North;

s0444.literal: Palace Attendant and Left Guard General Ren Zhong was made Commander of the Northern Campaign Vanguard with the additional title General Who Levels the North;
s0444.idiomatic: Palace Attendant and Left Guard General Ren Zhong was made commander of the northern vanguard and promoted to General Who Levels the North;

s0445.literal: former Inspector of Feng Province Gao Wenqin led three thousand foot and horse toward Yangping Commandery.
s0445.idiomatic: former Feng Province inspector Gao Wenqin led three thousand foot and horse toward Yangping commandery.

s0446.literal: On guimao day, Ren Zhong led seven thousand foot and horse toward Qin Commandery.
s0446.idiomatic: On guimao day Ren Zhong led seven thousand foot and horse toward Qin commandery.

s0447.literal: On jingwu day, the newly appointed General of Benevolent Might and Right Guard General Lu Guangda led troops into the Huai.
s0447.idiomatic: On jingwu day the newly appointed General of Benevolent Might and Right Guard General Lu Guangda led troops into the Huai.

s0448.literal: That day, Fan Yi led twenty thousand water troops from Dongguan into Jiao Lake; General of Martial Resolution Xiao Mohe led foot and horse toward Liyang.
s0448.idiomatic: That same day Fan Yi led twenty thousand sailors from Dongguan into Jiao Lake; General of Martial Resolution Xiao Mohe led foot and horse toward Liyang.

s0449.literal: On wushen day, Yu Province fell.
s0449.idiomatic: On wushen day Yu Province was lost.

s0450.literal: On xinhai day, Huo Province also fell.
s0450.idiomatic: On xinhai day Huo Province fell as well.

s0451.literal: On guichou day, the newly appointed Grand General of the Central Guard and Yangzhou Inspector Prince Shixing, Shuling, was made Grand Commander-in-Chief, commanding all water and land forces.
s0451.idiomatic: On guichou day the newly appointed Grand General of the Central Guard and Yangzhou inspector Prince Shixing, Shuling, was made grand commander of all land and water forces.

s0452.literal: In the twelfth month, on yichou day, the three provinces of Southern Yan, Northern Yan, and Jin, and the nine
s0452.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yichou day, the three provinces of Southern Yan, Northern Yan, and Jin, and the nine

s0454.literal: [commanderies]—[27] Xuyi, Shanyang, Yangping, Matou, Qin, Liyang, Pei, Northern Qiao, and Southern Liang—each broke away and returned to the capital.
s0454.idiomatic: [commanderies]—[27] Xuyi, Shanyang, Yangping, Matou, Qin, Liyang, Pei, Northern Qiao, and Southern Liang—all withdrew to the capital.

s0455.literal: Qiao and Northern Xuzhou also fell.
s0455.idiomatic: Qiao and Northern Xuzhou were lost as well.

s0456.literal: From this time the lands south of the Huai were entirely lost to Zhou.
s0456.idiomatic: From this time all the Huainan region fell to Zhou.

s0457.literal: On jisi day, an edict said: "Of old Yao and Shun above had thatched houses and earthen steps; Tang and Yu as rulers wore rush sandals and leather belts.
s0457.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict said: "Of old Yao and Shun dwelt in thatched halls on earthen steps; Tang and Yu wore rush sandals and leather belts.

s0458.literal: As for armored canopies and pearl cords, painted rafters and jade finials—they could not bring Yongxi, and only spread extravagant desire.
s0458.idiomatic: Armored canopies and pearl cords, painted beams and jade finials could not bring peace, and only fed extravagance.

s0459.literal: We look up to the former sages and think to seek fair lawsuits; the upright way is often left, and the shallow wind is not governed.
s0459.idiomatic: We look up to the former sages and seek fair justice; the straight path is often missed and shallow custom runs wild.

s0460.literal: Down to today the noble lanes and great houses have gold door-stops and jade shoes, while the poor in mean alleys eat pig-gruel and wear ox-hide—to weigh goods and level gifts, how far that is!
s0460.idiomatic: Today great houses sport gold thresholds and jade shoes while the poor in mean lanes eat pig-gruel and wear ox-hide—to weigh goods and level gifts, how far we are from that!

s0461.literal: Beacon fires have not ceased, corvée and tax together weary the people, and clerks cheat and seize, recklessly moving statutes and rules.
s0461.idiomatic: Beacon fires have not ceased, corvée and tax together weary the people, and clerks cheat and seize, recklessly shifting statutes and rules.

s0462.literal: Moreover at market pavilions and pass offices taxes and levies are numerous; they do not broaden money within the capital, nor supply the water office's expenses, but press merchants and traders and scheme for private hoards.
s0462.idiomatic: At market pavilions and pass offices taxes multiply; they do not fill the capital treasury nor meet the water office's costs, but squeeze merchants and scheme for private hoards.

s0463.literal: To quiet the people's many ills, affairs should be changed and renewed.
s0463.idiomatic: To ease the people's many ills, policy must be changed and renewed.

s0464.literal: Will you not spread the kingly way and peacefully rescue the people's harm?
s0464.idiomatic: Will you not spread the kingly way and peacefully rescue the people's harm?

s0465.literal: Now proclaim to the Master of Garments, the Palace Workshops, and all hall offices: unless required for state and army, do not repair and make many things.
s0465.idiomatic: Now proclaim to the Master of Garments, the Palace Workshops, and all hall offices: unless state or army require it, do not manufacture goods in quantity.

s0466.literal: In the rear palace ranks, if any wander long, the palace administration shall memorialize and they shall at once be sent away in due measure.
s0466.idiomatic: In the rear palace, if any linger without duty, the palace administration shall report and they shall be dismissed at once.

s0467.literal: Secret entertainments of the Grand Music Master do not meet ritual canon; music-office singers and actors do not accord with elegant correctness—all may be cut and revised.
s0467.idiomatic: Secret shows of the Grand Music Master violate ritual; music-office singers and actors are not proper elegance—all may be cut back.

s0468.literal: Market appraisals and ferry taxes, military orders and state statutes, must again be judged in detail, seeking only fairness and evenness.
s0468.idiomatic: Market appraisals and ferry taxes, military orders and state statutes, must be reviewed in detail and kept fair and even.

s0469.literal: Separate viewing halls and detached palaces, suburbs and open country—where there are not regular sacrifices and feasts, do not repair them again.
s0469.idiomatic: Detached palaces and suburban lodges—where there are not regular rites and feasts, do not repair them again.

s0470.literal: Also command civil and military within and without in carriages, horses, houses, and dwellings all to follow thrift and not prize luxury.
s0470.idiomatic: Also command civil and military, within and without, in carriage, horse, house, and dwelling to follow thrift and not prize luxury.

s0471.literal: Whoever violates Our stern regulations—there is also penal law.
s0471.idiomatic: Whoever violates Our stern rules shall face penal law.

s0472.literal: The responsible offices shall fully set out articles and rules, post them as placards and proclaim them, to make known Our heart.
s0472.idiomatic: The responsible offices shall draw up full articles and rules, post and proclaim them, and make Our intent known.

s0473.literal: On guiyou day, General Who Levels the North Shen Ke and General of Lightning Might Pei Zilie were stationed at Southern Xuzhou; General Who Opens the Distance Xu Daonu was stationed at Zhakou; former Inspector of Xin Province Yang Bao'an was stationed at Baixia.
s0473.idiomatic: On guiyou day General Who Levels the North Shen Ke and General of Lightning Might Pei Zilie garrisoned Southern Xuzhou; General Who Opens the Distance Xu Daonu garrisoned Zhakou; former Xin Province inspector Yang Bao'an garrisoned Baixia.

s0474.literal: On wuyin day, Central Army Commander Fan Yi was made General Who Pacifies the West and Area Commander of the four provinces Jing, Ying, Ba, and Wu for land and water affairs.
s0474.idiomatic: On wuyin day Central Army Commander Fan Yi was made General Who Pacifies the West and area commander of Jing, Ying, Ba, and Wu for land and water forces.

s0475.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year, in the first month, on wuxu day, Palace Attendant and Left Guard General Ren Zhong was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Southern Yu, commanding coastal river defense.
s0475.idiomatic: In spring of the twelfth year, on wuxu of the first month, Palace Attendant and Left Guard General Ren Zhong was made General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Southern Yu, commanding coastal defense along the river.

s0476.literal: In the third month, on renchen day, General Who Levels the North Prince of Luling, Boren, was made Left Wing General and Central Army Commander.
s0476.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen day, General Who Levels the North Prince of Luling, Boren, was made Left Wing General and central army commander.

s0477.literal: In the fourth month, on guihai day, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Shan died.
s0477.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guihai day, Left Vice Director Lu Shan died.

s0478.literal: On yichou day, General Who Proclaims Resolution Prince of Hedong, Shuxian, was made Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.
s0478.idiomatic: On yichou day General Who Proclaims Resolution Prince of Hedong, Shuxian, was appointed inspector of Southern Xuzhou.

s0479.literal: On jimao day, a great rain-prayer was held.
s0479.idiomatic: On jimao day a great rain-prayer was held.

s0481.literal: In the fifth month, on guisi day, Military Adviser General and Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Jin'an, Bogong, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
s0481.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guisi day, Military Adviser General and Right Vice Director Prince of Jin'an, Bogong, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.

s0482.literal: In the sixth month, on renxu day, a great wind destroyed the central gate-tower of the Gaomen.
s0482.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renxu day, a great wind destroyed the central tower of the Gaomen gate.

s0483.literal: In the eighth month, on jiwei day, Zhou's Bearer of the Staff, Supreme Pillar of State, and Area Commander of Ying Province, Duke of Xingyang, Sima Xiaonan, with the nine provinces Ying, Sui, Wen, Ying, Tu, Shun, Mian, and
s0483.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei day, Zhou's bearer of the staff, supreme pillar of state, and Ying Province commander Duke of Xingyang, Sima Xiaonan, with the nine provinces Ying, Sui, Wen, Ying, Tu, Shun, Mian, and

s0485.literal: Huan, Editorial footnote marker 28. Yue, and the eight garrisons Lushan, Zengshan, Chunyang, Yingcheng, Pingjing, Wuyang, Shangming, and Yunshui submitted inward. Editorial footnote marker 29.
s0485.idiomatic: Huan, see editorial note 28. Yue, and the eight garrisons Lushan, Zengshan, Chunyang, Yingcheng, Pingjing, Wuyang, Shangming, and Yunshui came over to Chen. See editorial note 29.

s0486.literal: An edict made Xiaonan Bearer of the Staff, Palace Attendant, Grand Commander-in-Chief, Area Commander of the nine provinces and eight garrisons An and Sui and all military affairs, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Minister of Works, enfeoffed as Duke of Sui Commandery, and granted one set each of drums, horns, and female musicians.
s0486.idiomatic: An edict made Xiaonan bearer of the staff, palace attendant, grand commander, area commander of the nine provinces and eight garrisons, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Minister of Works, enfeoffed him Duke of Sui, and granted one set each of drums, horns, and female musicians.

s0487.literal: On gengshen day, an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the West Fan Yi to advance and command the Mian and Han region.
s0487.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the West Fan Yi to take command of the Mian and Han region.

s0488.literal: General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Southern Yu Ren Zhong was sent to lead troops toward Liyang;
s0488.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the South and Southern Yu inspector Ren Zhong was sent with troops toward Liyang;

s0489.literal: Palace Attendant of Direct Communication and General of Surpassing Martiality Chen Huiji was made Commander of the Vanguard, toward Southern Yanzhou.
s0489.idiomatic: palace attendant of direct communication and General of Surpassing Martiality Chen Huiji was made vanguard commander toward Southern Yanzhou.

s0490.literal: On wuchen day, the newly appointed Minister of Works Sima Xiaonan was made Grand Commander-in-Chief of land and water forces.
s0490.idiomatic: On wuchen day the newly appointed Minister of Works Sima Xiaonan was made grand commander of land and water forces.

s0491.literal: On gengwu day, Palace Attendant of Direct Communication Chunyu Ling captured Linjiang Commandery.
s0491.idiomatic: On gengwu day palace attendant of direct communication Chunyu Ling captured Linjiang commandery.

s0492.literal: On guiyou day, General of Sagely Martiality Lu Guangda captured Guo Mo's city.
s0492.idiomatic: On guiyou day General of Sagely Martiality Lu Guangda captured Guo Mo's city.

s0493.literal: On jiaxu day, great rain fell for many days.
s0493.idiomatic: On jiaxu day heavy rain fell for many days.

s0494.literal: On jingzi day, Chunyu Ling captured You Province's city.
s0494.idiomatic: On jingzi day Chunyu Ling captured the city of You Province.

s0495.literal: In the ninth month, on guiwei day, Zhou's Administrator of Linjiang, Liu Xianguang, led his troops to submit inward.
s0495.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei day, Zhou's Linjiang administrator Liu Xianguang brought his troops over to Chen.

s0496.literal: That night, in the southeast of the sky there was a sound like wind and water striking one another; after three nights it ceased.
s0496.idiomatic: That night the southeast sky gave a sound like wind and water clashing; after three nights it stopped.

s0497.literal: On jingxu day, Anlu Commandery was changed to Southern Sizhou.
s0497.idiomatic: On jingxu day Anlu commandery was renamed Southern Sizhou.

s0498.literal: On dinghai day, Zhou's general Wang Yangui led troops to relieve Liyang; Ren Zhong attacked and defeated him, capturing Yangui alive.
s0498.idiomatic: On dinghai day Zhou general Wang Yangui led troops to relieve Liyang; Ren Zhong defeated him and took Yangui alive.

s0499.literal: On jiyou day, the righteous leader of Guangling in Zhou, Cao Yao, led his troops to submit inward.
s0499.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Guangling loyalist Cao Yao brought his following into allegiance.
